posts.tagline: Web analytics your visitors never have to consent to
posts.description: Klar is privacy-first web analytics: no cookies, no fingerprinting, no personal data — so nothing to ask consent for, and no banner. One script tag, 1.9 KB. Pageviews, referrers, countries, devices, UTMs, custom events, goals, and funnels with per-step drop-off. Free for 100,000 pageviews a month across 3 sites — and importing your history from Plausible or Fathom is on the free plan too. During the beta the first 1,000 signups get Pro free for 30 days, no card.

posts.name: Veya
posts.tagline: Context-first dating to fix swipe fatigue
posts.description: A lightweight dating prototype testing prompt-driven, context-first matching instead of superficial swipe decks. Early preview demo and waitlist are live.

posts.name: Goleador
posts.tagline: Daily football games built by a fan, for fans
posts.description: Goleador is a set of 6 daily football games I built solo. Guess the score of a real match, recolor a team's badge from memory, complete a hidden standings table, or guess a player from career clues. Everything resets daily and ranks you against other players globally or by favorite team. It's free, works in English and Spanish, and I'm still actively adding games based on feedback. Would love for football fans to try it!

posts.name: Okra for Mac
posts.tagline: Private document processing on your computer
posts.description: Have to process private documents that you can't upload anywhere? Okra reads them on your Mac: local OCR and layout models, every block linked back to the page, redaction you approve one by one, and Markdown, JSON, or CSV export. Free. No account.

posts.name: Framecast — Turn Any Website Into Video
posts.tagline: From URL to Video. In Seconds.
posts.description: Framecast turns any URL into a polished product video. Paste a link, it scrolls your site cleanly, drops the capture into a laptop or display mockup, and exports MP4, MOV, GIF, or a still — sized for every platform. No screen recorder, no editing timeline.

posts.name: Proxima Forma
posts.tagline: Design at the speed of AI
posts.description: Your creative direction, agents do the work. Design with ChatGPT, Claude, or your custom agent on one shared, editable canvas.

posts.name: HookDeploy
posts.tagline: Webhook infra with private delivery, no open ports
posts.description: I spent years as the accidental IT person at mid-size companies, cleaning up silently dropped webhooks after every cloud outage. So I built HookDeploy: every webhook is captured at the edge before forwarding, turning outages into a one-click replay instead of a week of manual reconciliation. Delivery to your own infra runs through a source-available mTLS agent, no open ports, no tunnel URLs. Includes a desktop agent, CLI, live Taps for local debugging, and a visual transform editor.

posts.name: UX Academy Accessibility Checker
posts.tagline: Scan any webpage for accessibility issues, free, no sign-up.
posts.description: Scan any public webpage for accessibility issues and receive a practical report in seconds. It is free and requires no sign-up. The checker is part of UX Academy’s collection of six free tools, alongside a contrast checker, readability checker, persona builder, journey map builder and empathy map builder.

posts.name: Scrui
posts.tagline: Clone web UIs with pixel-perfect fidelity
posts.description: Scrui reconstructs modern web UIs by capturing their rendered DOM, styles, assets, interactions, responsive states, and animations. Instead of saving a screenshot or static HTML, it analyzes the browser state and generates a functional clone designed to closely match the original experience.

posts.name: Photographers Journal
posts.tagline: Never lose a photo spot. Build your own photography map.
posts.description: PhotoJournal is a simple app for photographers and travelers to save places worth coming back to. Found a great photo spot, hidden beach, viewpoint, café, or hiking trail? Save the location in seconds, add a photo or note, and return later. Organize your places with tags and favorites, then navigate back whenever the time is right. Over time, PhotoJournal becomes your personal map of places you’ve photographed, explored, and never want to forget. Your places. Your memories. Your map.

posts.name: Next.js 15 Directory Boilerplate
posts.tagline: Production-ready Next.js 15 & React 19 SaaS starter kit
posts.description: Build and monetize directory platforms or Micro-SaaS apps in hours, not weeks. Packed with Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Prisma, PostgreSQL, i18n (EN/ES), hybrid guest/auth bookmarks, paid featured listings, and built-in Lemon Squeezy webhooks. Fully type-safe with unit tests included.

posts.name: UX Components: Design System Reference
posts.tagline: A reference for UI components across 210 design systems.
posts.description: UX Components is a practical, open reference for UI components across design systems. Browse by category or through the atomic design hierarchy, compare semantic naming and component states side by side, and dig into a directory of 210 design systems. It also covers universal icons and icon libraries, W3C ARIA patterns (including the ones no system has mapped), a DESIGN.md reference, and an MCP server so agents can pull the same data.

posts.name: Toddler Coloring Games
posts.tagline: Baby Drawing & Painting Book
posts.description: Kids Coloring App is a fun and easy painting app for toddlers and young children. Kids can color cute animals, vehicles, nature scenes, dinosaurs, and many other fun pictures while learning and being creative. The app includes simple drawing tools, bright colors, stickers, and a kid-friendly interface designed for little hands. Children can draw, paint, color, and save their artwork to enjoy later.

posts.name: rankveo
posts.tagline: SEO and AI search visibility in one workspace
posts.description: Rankveo brings SEO and AI search visibility into one workspace. Find keyword opportunities, plan and publish articles, track rankings, and see which AI engines mention or cite your brand. Monitor AI crawler visits and the pages they read, so you can connect content work with search and AI visibility.

posts.name: Should I Use It
posts.tagline: Paste a URL. Get a buy or don't-buy fit check.
posts.description: Should I Use It is an independent product advisor. Paste any product or app URL and get a clear verdict: worth it, skip, or depends. Each report covers fit, pricing, gotchas, and alternatives, with claims linked back to public sources. No account. No billing. No sponsored verdicts.

posts.name: dopi
posts.tagline: A focus timer you can see.
posts.description: dopi shows the time you have left as a shrinking red wedge, the way a paper clock face does. When the wedge runs out, it hands you a dopi task, one small thing to do while your break runs, then puts you back to work with a nice chill tune.

posts.name: Context Atlas
posts.tagline: Find answers you can verify on the page you’re reading
posts.description: Context Atlas is a Chrome extension that helps you understand a webpage without losing the source. Ask a question and get ranked page matches, then jump to the exact words that support each result. Search locally in your browser with an on-device model or choose optional Cloud search. It is free, open source, and built for answers you can verify.

posts.name: BroadPaper
posts.tagline: Recurring client reports, without the recurring work
posts.description: For anyone who rebuilds the same client report every month. Bring your spreadsheet, design the report once, and get a branded PDF per client. BroadPaper matches your columns, asking only when unsure. Next month: new figures, same button. Free plan. Developers can also embed the same visual designer directly into React or Angular apps.

posts.name: AIWatermark: C2PA Conformant
posts.tagline: Neural watermarks + C2PA credentials anyone can verify
posts.description: AIWatermark is now on the C2PA Conforming Products List (Assurance Level 1). Every image, video and audio file gets a Meta Seal neural watermark plus a CA-signed C2PA manifest any independent reader can verify. Our three registered C2PA soft-binding algorithms (IDs 30, 31, 32) let a stripped file find its manifest again. Plus: free verifier, owner registry with reverse image search, batches of 50, CDN hosting and an API for AI agents. $19/mo, 14-day trial, no card.

posts.name: DishRoam
posts.tagline: Compact dishwasher for your RV motorhome
posts.description: DishRoam is a compact dishwasher for your campervan drawer. Enjoy everyday dishwashing convenience wherever you park. More travelling, less washing up.

posts.name: B2B Agency Matchmaker
posts.tagline: Human-vetted private network connecting brands and agencies
posts.description: Finding the right agency or landing qualified client leads takes months of wasted effort. We built a private, human-vetted network that manually matches top-tier agencies with brands, backed by a performance guarantee.

posts.name: Sticraft
posts.tagline: Free PDF, image and design tools. No signup.
posts.description: Sticraft is a free, browser-based toolkit for everyday PDF and image work. Use 105 tools with no signup: merge or split PDFs, resize or compress images, and turn raster images into SVG with the vectorizer. Files are processed in your browser. Available in 10 languages. Free to use, supported by ads.

posts.name: Pomp
posts.tagline: Gift registries for everything worth celebrating
posts.description: Pomp is the registry site for everything worth celebrating. Pomp helps you connect with friends, family, and loved ones by providing a platform for thoughtful gifting for any occasion. Traditional registry websites were made for weddings or baby showers. We encourage you to use Pomp for every occasion — housewarming parties, divorces, graduations, and more! Paste a link from any store and spread joy with friends and family. Launch day promo: 1 month free via https://pompregistry.com/launch-day

posts.name: Scroll+
posts.tagline: Turn PDFs into comfortable reading. Build a daily habit.
posts.description: Scroll+ is an Android reader for your PDF and EPUB books. Turn complex PDF pages into text that fits your screen with optional server processing (subscription required). Adjust fonts and reading themes, read imported books offline, and build a habit with daily streaks, Nova points and Loomy companions. Free to download with ads and in-app purchases. PDF results depend on the source; OCR errors can remain.

posts.name: Stali API
posts.tagline: api.stali.vn — One API for Powerful AI Models, Fast & Simple
posts.description: Vietnamese Claude API & AI API — Access 70+ AI models including Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, GLM, Grok, MiniMax, and AWS models Pricing starts from 1,500 VND per 1,000,000 tokens or just 230 VND per API call. Top up easily in VND via VietQR, with full support for both Anthropic SDK and OpenAI SDK Includes 20 AWS-powered AI models, with full VAT invoices available api.stali.vn has been officially notified to the Vietnam Ministry of Industry and Trade and is listed on online.gov.vn

posts.name: Flip Hop
posts.tagline: Daily On-chain Micro-Stake Game
posts.description: Flip Hop is a global $5 daily on-chain micro-stake game. One round runs every day, with one winner and results anyone can verify on-chain. Randomness is powered by Chainlink VRF, settlement uses USDC on Base, and the smart contract is publicly verifiable. Simple mechanics, transparent results, no black-box draw.

posts.name: RealPost Pro
posts.tagline: AI property photos & motion for estate agents
posts.description: RealPost Pro turns the property photos you already have into polished listing visuals. AI photo enhancement balances light and clarity while keeping proportions true; AI motion clips turn stills into short cinematic walk-throughs. Built for estate agents who want a better first impression with less admin. Local previews are free; sign in to save your own photos. Originals stay intact.
